purpose: Freeze the minimum probability-scale routeability-specific effects worth detecting before procedural pilot nuisance values or confirmatory treatment contrasts are opened.

provenance.primary_rationale: A 0.10 probability-scale interaction corresponds to one additional correct decision per ten test trials attributable to the routeability-specific architecture-by-access contrast. Smaller effects are treated as biologically too small to justify the full 12-cell controlled experiment as a mechanism claim.
provenance.same_threshold_for_H1_H2: Using the same 0.10 threshold prevents a weaker post-hoc standard for budget localization than for the primary B2 interaction.

literature_context_only.role: bumblebee flower-learning work used 80% correct visits as an acquisition criterion
trained bumblebees reached greater than 85% accuracy in an artificial-flower size discrimination task

literature_context_only.citation: Church et al. 2001, Great Lakes Entomologist 34:85-95, doi:10.22543/0090-0222.2052
literature_context_only.role: color discrimination in artificial flowers reached very high accuracy; used only to establish that 10 percentage points is behaviorally interpretable, not to estimate the focal effect

firewalls.theoretical_information_ceiling: The exact 0.25 routeability information ceiling is not an effect-size estimate and is forbidden as the power target.
firewalls.pilot: No observed routeable-versus-bypass, contingent-versus-fixed, H1 or H2 effect from the procedural pilot may alter the frozen 0.10 SESOI.
firewalls.confirmatory: SESOI cannot be changed after treatment contrasts are opened.
firewalls.literature: External discrimination accuracies are contextual and are not converted into a meta-analytic expected H1/H2 effect.

power_interface.use: These exact values and provenance must be identical in every robustness scenario and candidate N in the final GLMM operating-characteristic surface.

claim_ceiling: The 0.10 values are smallest-worthwhile-effect thresholds for design and interpretation, not predictions of the true behavioral effect. A smaller estimated effect may be scientifically nonzero but is below the predeclared mechanism-relevance threshold.
